notice: 77 endpoint records transcribed from BintangAPI documentation snapshot dated 2026-11-10. Documentation presence is not live verification, permission to redistribute upstream code, or a guarantee of availability. Playground simulation never sends upstream requests.

sourceSnapshot.attribution: BintangAPI describes itself as a REST wrapper around scraper and script collections from StarLabs. No upstream source code or scraper implementation was copied.
